items.summary: Delivered retail measurement solutions across Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, covering sampling design, quality assurance, and population estimation. Developed an NLP-powered address-matching solution that improved identification accuracy and reduced manual processing.

Developed methodologies and core algorithms for digital advertising measurement products in collaboration with engineering teams. Reduced R-based factor computation from 40 minutes to under 10 seconds and increased age-prediction accuracy from 67% to 91% using XGBoost.

Built an end-to-end market intelligence workflow for Dewu, spanning insight generation, dashboard delivery, and real-time monitoring. Developed a Python automation stack that cut manual reporting by over 90%, and applied LLMs to improve automotive aftermarket category classification.

Develop and maintain algorithms for NielsenIQ’s eCommerce and O2O measurement products, supporting accurate and consistent market measurement. Improve methodology reliability, production stability, and delivery efficiency through scalable analytical solutions.
